nodes.name: AbstractCaptchaService.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base implementation of CaptchaService: reads configuration, caches base images, wires frequency limiting, and provides shared validation, decryption, and font/image utilities for concrete captcha types.

nodes.name: AbstractCaptchaService
nodes.summary: Template base class implementing CaptchaService; subclasses override get/check/verification while inheriting config loading, cache lookup, client-id resolution, and fail-count tracking.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the captcha service from Properties: loads watermark/font/slip-offset/AES settings, pre-caches base images, starts the local cache, registers a shutdown hook, and installs the frequency-limit handler.

nodes.name: verification
nodes.summary: Template verification step that rejects empty verification codes and delegates per-minute verify-frequency limiting to the configured handler.

nodes.name: getValidateClientId
nodes.summary: Resolves the client identity used for rate limiting: MD5 of browser info when present, otherwise the clientUid, otherwise null.

nodes.name: afterValidateFail
nodes.summary: Increments and persists the per-client failed-validation counter in the cache after a failed captcha check.

nodes.name: loadWaterMarkFont
nodes.summary: Loads the configured TrueType/OpenType watermark font from the classpath /fonts directory, falling back to a built-in default on error.

nodes.name: base64StrToImage
nodes.summary: Decodes a base64 image string and writes it to a file path, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: getEnOrChLength
nodes.summary: Computes the display width of a mixed Chinese/English string, counting multi-byte characters as full width for watermark layout.

nodes.name: BlockPuzzleCaptchaServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Sliding block-puzzle captcha implementation: cuts a jigsaw piece from a background image, caches the expected point, and verifies user drag position within a slip offset.

nodes.name: BlockPuzzleCaptchaServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Block-puzzle CaptchaService implementation with pixel-level template cutting, interference options, AES-protected point tokens, and cache-backed verification.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Generates a new block-puzzle captcha: draws the watermark, selects a jigsaw template, cuts the piece, and returns base64 images plus token metadata.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Validates the user's drag point against the cached point within the slip offset, tracks failures, and on success issues an AES-encrypted second-verification token.

nodes.name: verification
nodes.summary: Performs second verification by checking and consuming the cached verification token (one-time use).

nodes.name: pictureTemplatesCut
nodes.summary: Cuts the jigsaw piece and background hole using the template image, applies interference, encodes both images to base64, and caches the resulting point under a UUID token.

nodes.name: extracted
nodes.summary: Applies random interference jigsaw shapes to the background image according to the configured interference option.

nodes.name: generateJigsawPoint
nodes.summary: Generates a random valid jigsaw position that keeps the piece clear of edges and the watermark area, attaching a fresh AES key.

nodes.name: cutByTemplate
nodes.summary: Pixel-loop template cut: copies opaque template pixels into the new image and whitens the corresponding region of the original with anti-aliased edges.

nodes.name: interferenceByTemplate
nodes.summary: Draws a decoy jigsaw-shaped interference pattern into the background image at a given x offset.

nodes.name: readPixel
nodes.summary: Reads the 3x3 pixel neighborhood around a coordinate into a matrix, tolerating image borders.

nodes.name: avgMatrix
nodes.summary: Computes the average RGB color of a 3x3 pixel matrix used for edge smoothing of the cut jigsaw shape.

nodes.name: CaptchaCacheServiceMemImpl.java
nodes.summary: In-memory implementation of CaptchaCacheService delegating all operations to the local CacheUtil store.

nodes.name: CaptchaCacheServiceMemImpl
nodes.summary: Local-memory cache backend for captcha tokens and rate-limit counters, reporting cache type 'local'.

nodes.name: CaptchaServiceFactory.java
nodes.summary: Static factory and registry that instantiates and initializes CaptchaService implementations by type and hands out the configured CaptchaCacheService backend.

nodes.name: CaptchaServiceFactory
nodes.summary: Holds the static instances map of captcha services keyed by type code plus the cache service registry populated by Spring auto-configuration.

nodes.name: getInstance
nodes.summary: Looks up the CaptchaService for the configured captcha type and initializes it with the given properties, failing fast on unsupported types.

nodes.name: ClickWordCaptchaServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Click-word captcha implementation: renders random Chinese characters onto a background image and verifies the user's clicked coordinates in order.

nodes.name: ClickWordCaptchaServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Click-word CaptchaService implementation with random word/point generation, AES-protected point lists, cache-backed ordered verification, and a large built-in Chinese character pool.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes click-word specific settings: word count, font color randomness, and the click-word TrueType font from the classpath.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Generates a new click-word captcha image and returns its base64 data and the ordered word list to click.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Validates the user's clicked point sequence against the cached points within tolerance, tracks failures, and issues an AES-encrypted second-verification token on success.

nodes.name: verification
nodes.summary: Consumes the cached one-time verification token to complete second verification.

nodes.name: getImageData
nodes.summary: Renders the random words onto the background with random colors and rotations, records their points under a UUID token in the cache, and returns the populated CaptchaVO.

nodes.name: getRandomWords
nodes.summary: Picks the requested number of distinct random Chinese characters from the built-in HAN_ZI pool.

nodes.name: randomWordPoint
nodes.summary: Computes a random non-overlapping placement point for a word within the image bounds, avoiding the watermark area.

nodes.name: DefaultCaptchaServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Delegating CaptchaService that routes get/check/verification calls to the concrete implementation matching the request's captcha type.

nodes.name: DefaultCaptchaServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Facade implementation that initializes all registered captcha services except itself and dispatches each request based on CaptchaVO.captchaType.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Validates the request and delegates captcha generation to the service matching the requested captcha type.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Validates captcha type and token presence, then delegates the answer check to the matching captcha service.

nodes.name: verification
nodes.summary: Performs second verification by validating and consuming the cached verification token directly against the cache backend.

nodes.name: FrequencyLimitHandler.java
nodes.summary: Request frequency-limit SPI with a default handler enforcing per-client get/check/verify rate limits and lock-out thresholds via the cache backend.

nodes.name: FrequencyLimitHandler
nodes.summary: Interface plus DefaultLimitHandler inner class that increments cached counters per client id and rejects requests exceeding configured minute limits or lock thresholds.

nodes.name: RotatePuzzleCaptchaServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Rotate-puzzle captcha implementation that serves a randomly rotated image and reuses the block-puzzle point checking logic.

nodes.name: RotatePuzzleCaptchaServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Rotate-puzzle CaptchaService implementation extending BlockPuzzleCaptchaServiceImpl, overriding only image selection and cache-service resolution.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Generates a rotate-puzzle captcha by fetching a rotated original image and its block counterpart, then delegates to the block-puzzle generation flow.

nodes.name: AesUtil.java
nodes.summary: AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding encryption utility with base64 helpers used to protect captcha point coordinates and verification tokens.

nodes.name: AesUtil
nodes.summary: Static AES utility offering key generation, byte- and string-level encrypt/decrypt, and base64 conversion helpers.

nodes.name: aesEncryptToBytes
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext content to raw bytes using AES with a SHA-1-seeded key generator derived from the given key.

nodes.name: aesEncrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts a string and returns the base64-encoded ciphertext; returns the input unchanged when blank.

nodes.name: aesDecryptByBytes
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-encrypted bytes back to a UTF-8 string using the key-derived cipher.

nodes.name: aesDecrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts a base64-encoded AES ciphertext string; returns the input unchanged when blank.
